article.title: Project 2025 takes shape in Latin America’s far-Right governments
article.author: Editor
article.content: The ultra-conservative document drafted by the Heritage Foundation as a roadmap for Republican governance has not only fulfilled the fascist dream of the United States, but this roadmap is now being used by the governments of the Shield of the Americas.
